subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to file consent upload requests

question: What minimum Microsoft Teams file-upload throughput should OpenClaw support before aborting an accepted transfer?
rationale: Microsoft defines the direct upload flow but no client deadline, while current OpenClaw is unbounded; selecting a fixed cutoff changes compatibility and needs explicit maintainer policy.

options.title: Require transfer-aware deadline
options.body: Derive the deadline from payload size with a documented floor and cap, and use the same policy for both upload paths.

options.title: Accept five-minute cutoff
options.body: Explicitly accept that otherwise valid uploads exceeding five minutes fail and require retry.

options.title: Pause both timeout PRs
options.body: Hold both branches until maintainers select one canonical transfer policy and helper contract.

recommendation.title: Require transfer-aware deadline
recommendation.body: Derive the deadline from payload size with a documented floor and cap, and use the same policy for both upload paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Git history directly attributes both the current upload implementation and shared timeout owner to their merged commit.
